report.summary: Database connection errors in payments-api were caused by a configuration sync job that inadvertently reduced the ledger-service connection pool size from 50 to 5, resulting in immediate pool exhaustion and connection timeouts starting at 13:15.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion in Ledger Service due to Config Normalization

supporting.note: Config change at 13:12 reduced db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5 for ledger-service.
Error rate anomaly started at 13:15 for ledger-service.
Error rate anomaly started at 13:15 for payments-api due to downstream dependency failure.
Ledger service logs showed HikariPool timeout with 5 active and 0 idle connections starting at 13:15.
Payments API logs showed ledger-service POST /entries failing with 503 could not acquire connection starting at 13:15.

contradicting.note: Request rate remained stable around ~280-310 req/s with no traffic surge during onset.
Request rate remained stable during onset.

facts.text: A config change chg-8919 modified ledger-service db.pool.max_size from 50 to 5 at 2026-10-06T13:12:00+00:00.
Error rates began rising for ledger-service and payments-api at 13:15.
Ledger service logged HikariPool connection timeout errors indicating pool size 5 with 5 active connections.
Payments API logged downstream connection errors calling ledger-service.

assumptions: The automated config sync script applied an incorrect normalization target of 5 instead of preserving higher sizing for ledger-service.

timeline.event: Config change chg-8919 executed on ledger-service setting db.pool.max_size to 5
P99 latency anomaly begins on ledger-service
Error rate anomaly starts on ledger-service and payments-api
First payments-api error logged for ledger-service connection failure
First ledger-service connection timeout error logged

recommended_actions.action: Roll back config change chg-8919 and restore ledger-service db.pool.max_size to 50
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly resolves connection pool exhaustion and restores successful payment confirmations.

recommended_actions.action: Audit automated config-sync jobs and normalization rules
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevent future overrides of critical database connection pool settings.

recommended_actions.action: Add alerting for database connection pool utilization approaching maximum capacity
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensure early detection of pool exhaustion before request timeouts occur.
